verdict.rationale: Auth0 FGA is described as a "unified, relationship-based platform" that decouples complex authorization logic from code. It is also shown enforcing document-level access control in RAG pipelines, which delivers resource-level authorization beyond the separately documented RBAC role/permission model. The evidence is mostly marketing-level first-party copy. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the authorization modeling language and relationship/policy definitions, evidence of policy-based (ABAC) rules beyond relationships, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
